items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: Well, getting back to this personnel at the Deluxe was Circa Johnny and they had a Wilman Bro, Roy Palmer, and Baby Hall, which later we called him, his name was Fred. We later called him Tubby Hall, you know. And Bishady played up there.

ctx.x: Well, as you grew on in years, did you hear any more music?

Oh yeah, I, in spite of me hearing this music, I used to say, the second line just like the rest of the kids. We used to try sometime way away from home, you know, out of the neighborhood. I remember I, I think it was about the 30th of May and some friends of mine and I, we, we came all the way down to French Bar Town and the boys got behind us and ran us all the way to the podgers and ramparts, you know. And so I always did love music. I used to do a lot of whistling. I still do. And so, but I didn't have no…
Where was he from? He's from New Orleans.
